integrity: Exact symbolic algebra and stationary balance tested; finite event-time simulation supports but does not prove general statements. Same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Hard jamming, linear attraction, equal propulsion speeds, no translational noise and strictly positive independent symmetric tumbling rates; zero-rate statements are limits only. General fluid-queue theory may contain equivalent implicit conclusions.
title: Heterogeneous tumbling sharpens the exponential binding length of a jammed two-swimmer pair
